title: BCM-X1 diagnostic sessions
text: BCM-X1 sessions: 0x01 default - Active after power-up and after any ECU reset.; 0x02 programming - Used for flashing; only reachable from the extended session (Demo OEM rule).; 0x03 extended - Used for configuration, routines and protected writes.

title: BCM-X1 security level 1
text: BCM-X1 SecurityAccess level 1: seed request sub-function 0x01, send key sub-function 0x02, available in extended session, seed and key 4 bytes, maximum 3 invalid keys then 10 s lockout.

title: BCM-X1 security level 3
text: BCM-X1 SecurityAccess level 3: seed request sub-function 0x03, send key sub-function 0x04, available in programming session, seed and key 4 bytes, maximum 3 invalid keys then 10 s lockout.

title: BCM-X1 supported services
text: Services implemented by BCM-X1: 0x10 DiagnosticSessionControl, 0x11 ECUReset, 0x14 ClearDiagnosticInformation, 0x19 ReadDTCInformation, 0x22 ReadDataByIdentifier, 0x27 SecurityAccess, 0x28 CommunicationControl, 0x2E WriteDataByIdentifier, 0x31 RoutineControl, 0x34 RequestDownload, 0x36 TransferData, 0x37 RequestTransferExit, 0x3E TesterPresent, 0x85 ControlDTCSetting. Any other service identifier is answered with NRC 0x11 serviceNotSupported.

title: DID 0xF186 activeDiagnosticSession
text: BCM-X1 DID 0xF186 activeDiagnosticSession - active diagnostic session: length 1 byte(s), access read-only, encoding uint, readable in default, programming, extended session(s). Note: Returns the current session id (dynamic).. Bench default value: 1.

text: BCM-X1 DID 0xF187 sparePartNumber - spare part number: length 11 byte(s), access read-only, encoding ascii, readable in default, programming, extended session(s). Bench default value: DM1234567AB.

text: BCM-X1 DID 0xF199 programmingDate - programming date: length 4 byte(s), access read/write, encoding bcd, readable in default, programming, extended session(s). Writable in programming session with security level 3. Note: YYYYMMDD in BCD.. Bench default value: 20260901.

title: DID 0xF1A0 calibrationIdentifier
text: BCM-X1 DID 0xF1A0 calibrationIdentifier - calibration identifier: length 8 byte(s), access read-only, encoding ascii, readable in default, programming, extended session(s). Bench default value: CAL00042.

title: DID 0x4A10 interiorLightTimeout
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A10 interiorLightTimeout - interior light timeout: length 2 byte(s), access read/write, encoding uint, readable in default, extended session(s). Writable in extended session with security level 1. Allowed range 5 to 300 s. Bench default value: 60.

title: DID 0x4A11 autoLockSpeedThreshold
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A11 autoLockSpeedThreshold - auto lock speed threshold: length 1 byte(s), access read/write, encoding uint, readable in default, extended session(s). Writable in extended session with security level 1. Allowed range 5 to 50 km/h. Bench default value: 15.

title: DID 0x4A12 welcomeLightEnable
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A12 welcomeLightEnable - welcome light enable: length 1 byte(s), access read/write, encoding enum, readable in default, extended session(s). Writable in extended session with no security access. Allowed range 0 to 1. Values: 0=disabled, 1=enabled. Bench default value: 1.

title: DID 0x4A13 rearWiperInterval
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A13 rearWiperInterval - rear wiper interval: length 1 byte(s), access read/write, encoding uint, readable in default, extended session(s). Writable in extended session with no security access. Allowed range 2 to 20 s. Bench default value: 8.

title: DID 0x4A20 batteryVoltage
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A20 batteryVoltage - battery voltage: length 2 byte(s), access read-only, encoding uint, readable in default, extended session(s). Scaling: 0.01 V per bit. Bench default value: 1260.

title: DID 0x4A21 ambientTemperature
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A21 ambientTemperature - ambient temperature: length 1 byte(s), access read-only, encoding uint, readable in default, extended session(s). Scaling: 1 degC per bit, offset -40. Bench default value: 62.

title: DID 0x4A22 doorStatus
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A22 doorStatus - door status: length 1 byte(s), access read-only, encoding bitfield, readable in default, extended session(s). Values: bit0=driver door open, bit1=passenger door open, bit2=rear left open, bit3=rear right open, bit4=tailgate open. Bench default value: 0.

title: DID 0x4A23 ignitionState
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A23 ignitionState - ignition state: length 1 byte(s), access read-only, encoding enum, readable in default, extended session(s). Values: 0=off, 1=accessory, 2=on, 3=crank. Bench default value: 2.

text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A30 lampOutputState - lamp output state: length 2 byte(s), access read-only, encoding bitfield, readable in extended session(s). Note: Only readable in the extended session.. Bench default value: 0.

title: DID 0x4A40 variantCoding
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A40 variantCoding - variant coding: length 4 byte(s), access read/write, encoding raw, readable in extended session(s). Writable in extended session with security level 1. Bench default value: 0102000F.

title: DID 0x4A41 marketRegion
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A41 marketRegion - market region: length 1 byte(s), access read/write, encoding enum, readable in default, extended session(s). Writable in extended session with security level 1. Allowed range 0 to 4. Values: 0=EU, 1=India, 2=North America, 3=China, 4=Rest of world. Bench default value: 1.

title: DID 0x4A60 learnedKeyFobCount
text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A60 learnedKeyFobCount - learned key fob count: length 1 byte(s), access read-only, encoding uint, readable in default, extended session(s). Bench default value: 2.

text: BCM-X1 DID 0x4A61 immobiliserStatus - immobiliser status: length 1 byte(s), access read-only, encoding enum, readable in extended session(s). Reading requires security level 1. Note: Reading requires extended session and security level 1.. Values: 0=armed, 1=disarmed. Bench default value: 0.
